lessons: A handoff doc that names a branch or a purchase goes stale silently, and the reader cannot tell. It cost real money-adjacent advice today: a wrong hardware line in PROJECT.md became wrong guidance to a person standing in a shop.
Do not write 'X is already in main' in a PR that has not merged. I did, and merging #9 alone would have made two files false on arrival.
For video bandwidth, measure bytes per second and not frame size. Halving resolution was measured to raise the frame rate ~1.75x, so the wire saving is far smaller than the pixel count implies.
Verify a library's default by running it rather than reciting it - the anyio 40-thread limiter is load-bearing for the stated viewer ceiling.
Stale web-search pricing is worse than no pricing when the user can read the real shelf tag. Ask them to paste the listing.
Cumulative usage counters are baselines, not results. Record the number before, not only after.
